name: Player's Handbook
blurb: The core rulebook. Most of what a player picks at character creation starts here.

name: Expanded Content
blurb: Community-maintained material published alongside the core books, broadening every category rather than adding a new one.

name: Wretched Hives
blurb: The galaxy's underworld: the gear and talents that come with a disreputable life.

name: Scum and Villainy
blurb: The bestiary. Every creature, droid and adversary in this reference comes from here.

name: Starships of the Galaxy
blurb: The other half of the game: hulls, crew stations, ship weapons and modifications, and the rules for flying and fighting in them.
